summary: CordovaCann Corp. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing historical Canadian public disclosure, including interim financial statements and MD&A for periods through March 31, 2026, plus archived news releases and a change-of-auditor package (former and successor auditor letters dated October 13, 2025). No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the filing merely complies with US foreign-private-issuer reporting for previously public Canadian materials. The only notable item is the auditor change. No deal terms exist to arbitrage; watch for future material-change filings or going-private activity given the micro-cap OTC profile.
